display_name: Source-only fixed verification threshold rehearsal on SatIQ and native PAMF-SUP
description: Validate the full calibration and fixed source threshold export on the two model families before final held-out scoring.
authorization: User requested PAMF-SUP adapted to SatIQ, no early augmentation, 100 epochs; all arms fully supervised.

data.dataset: Oxford SatIQ Zenodo 8220494, first 1010464 chronological packets
data.representation: Same physical source packets and split. SatIQ uses the 11000-point full preamble; PAMF-SUP native arms use the existing five branches over the 8000-sample common prefix.
data.support_query_ref: Transient source V enrollment K1/16. Independent T (50000) separately staged; no training access.

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen L/V readout only. Both whole-vector and independent-block calibration estimated on shared 8192 source L packets. No T access.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Two existing first-epoch checkpoints are only used to verify the end-to-end source threshold path. No held-out inputs or labels.

execution.launch_owner: Single sequential calibration and threshold source rehearsal worker
execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU4, >=4096 MiB free and <=2 incumbent processes.
